description: Shows the signed-in customer's 4OVER4 account: profile, saved addresses or QR codes; use it when someone asks about their own 4OVER4 account details. For orders use get_my_orders; for coins use get_my_coins. The section input is optional and defaults to profile. Returns name, email, phone, business and default addresses, every saved address, or saved QR codes. Needs the customer's 4OVER4 sign-in. Customer phrases: "show my profile", "what addresses do I have on file", "my saved QR codes".
name: get_my_profile
